text: Objectives The master program in Engineering Mechanics aims to provide solid theory and technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level researching and teaching, and solve engineering problems. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and committed. After the program, student may find jobs in high tech companies, teaching and research institutions. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Biomechanics 2. Fracture Mechnaics 3. Computational Mechanics 4. Micro-nano Mechanics 5. Structural Mechanics 6. Elastic Dynamics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 33 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
